name: Murayama (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Murayama city emblem in white: a stylised triangular device like the character 山 with a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Murayama, a city in Yamagata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 25 August 1955.

features.role: Murayama city emblem — a stylised triangular device like the character 山 with a ring
